issues: 数字只有 74px（设计坐标放大后仍偏小），四周大面积空黑，标签 10px 级小字读不清
计数是整数直接跳变，快段只靠整体模糊，没有"滚"的机械感，冲到终值也没有落定的那一下
纸屑是 8 色荧光彩虹，和深蓝底、蓝白数字不在一个色系，像游戏特效
冲击环 + 柔闪 + 中心辉光三种光效叠在一起，主次不清
changes: look 换成 ember（暖黑 · 橙 · 金）香槟夜：268px 渐变金白数字占画宽 70%，眉题 MILESTONE 30px、副标题 64px、致谢 32px 三级层级
计数器改七位机械滚轮：真实进位规则、低位按转速竖向模糊变虚、未到高位是暗色幽灵零（开场第 1 帧就有 0,000,000）
节奏改「快—慢—停—咔」：expo-out 冲到 0,999,999 → 停 2f → 六位同时 9→0、最高位 0→1 的弹簧进位（~8% 过冲）
抢拍保留：两门礼炮在进位起跳同一帧射出 120 片金箔 / 橙 / 奶白三色纸屑，金箔随翻转反光，阻力抛体 + 飘摆 + 三层景深
光效收成一次：落定时数字弹一下 + 背后金色泛光 + 横向光带，去掉冲击环
时长 172f：纸屑 ~160f 前落出画外，尾帧是干净的里程碑海报
issuesEn: The number was only 74px in design space and still small after scaling, floating in empty black; the 10px-class label was unreadable
The count jumped as plain integers with a global blur on fast frames: no mechanical roll, and no settle when it hit the final value
Confetti used an 8-colour neon rainbow that clashed with the navy stage and blue-white number, reading like a game effect
Shock ring, soft flash and centre glow stacked three light effects with no clear hierarchy
changesEn: Warm ember look (warm black, orange, gold): a 268px gold-white gradient number spanning 70% of the frame, with a three-level hierarchy of 30px MILESTONE kicker, 64px line and 32px thank-you
The counter is now a seven-digit mechanical odometer: real carry rules, fast digits blur and fade with spin speed, unreached digits sit as dark ghost zeros (0,000,000 is on screen from frame 1)
Rhythm is fast, slow, pause, clunk: expo-out to 0,999,999, a 2f pause, then a spring carry that rolls six 9s to 0 and the top digit 0 to 1 (~8% overshoot)
The early beat is kept: two cannons fire 120 pieces of gold foil, orange and cream confetti on the carry frame, with foil glints, drag ballistics, flutter and three depth layers
One light accent only: on landing the number bumps, a gold bloom and a horizontal streak flash behind it; the shock ring is gone
172f total: the confetti clears the frame by ~160f, so the last frame is a clean milestone poster
